audience: sales and operations teams that send proposals, quotes and documents from Qwilr

useCases.title: Find pages by status and owner
useCases.text: List pages newest first, filtered by status, tag or owner. Open one page to read its links and expiry, and who accepted it.

useCases.title: Read the taxes and payment gateways
useCases.text: List the taxes defined in the account with their rates. List the payment gateways that pages can take payments through.

useCases.title: Create a draft page from saved blocks
useCases.text: List the saved blocks, then create a page from them. The page stays a draft unless you set it to publish.

useCases.title: Publish a page and set its link expiry
useCases.text: Publish or unpublish a page, and set when its link expires. A published page's link works for anyone who has it.

useCases.title: See who owns each page
useCases.text: List the users with their roles and teams. Use an owner id to filter the pages that person owns.
